versions.changelog: v1.1.1: 修复 SkillHub latest tag，确保 1.1.x 成为默认安装版本
v1.1.0: 增加增量同步(incremental/ingest)、自动迭代机制与文档更新

- Initial release of hippocampus-memory-engine, an external memory engine for Agents inspired by hippocampal neural circuits.
- Supports unified vectorization, persistence, RAG retrieval, automatic distillation, SVG visualization, and sync with Obsidian or GitHub.
- Enables regular synchronization and merging of scattered knowledge sources (logs, knowledge bases, archives).
- Provides Python API and CLI tools for syncing, visualizing, and retrieving knowledge.
- Minimal dependency (requires only numpy); designed for offline use with no model downloads.
